tool.name: FoldX BuildModel
tool.description: estimate mutation ΔΔG and generate mutant structures
tool.command: #set $repair_arg = "" #if str($repair) == "true": #set $repair_arg = "--repair" #end if #set $mutation_file_arg = "" #if str($mutation_source.source) == "file": #set $mutation_file_arg = "--mutation-file '%s'" % $mutation_source.mutation_file #else: #set $mutation_file_arg = "--mutations '%s'" % $mutation_source.mutations #end if #set $foldx_command_arg = "" #if str($foldx_command) not in ["", "None"]: #set $foldx_command_arg = "--foldx-command '%s'" % $foldx_command #end if python '$__tool_directory__/run_foldx.py' --mode buildmodel --pdb '$pdb' $repair_arg $mutation_file_arg $foldx_command_arg --pH '$ph' --temperature '$temperature' --ionic-strength '$ionic_strength' --number-of-runs '$number_of_runs' --ddg-output 'ddg.fxout' --repaired-pdb 'repaired.pdb' --mutant-structures-dir 'mutant_structures' --summary-json 'summary.json' --archive 'foldx_outputs.zip' --run-log 'run_log.txt'

param.name: mutations
param.label: FoldX mutation list
param.help: One mutation set per line, for example GA1V; or GA1V,LB42A;. A trailing semicolon is added if omitted.

tool.help:
FoldX BuildModel estimates mutation energy changes and writes mutant structures. Mutation syntax follows FoldX ``individual_list.txt`` conventions, for example ``GA1V;`` for Gly A 1 Val or comma-separated multiple mutations ending in ``;``.
FoldX is licensed software and must be installed separately on the server. Set ``FOLDX_BINARY`` in ``config/job_conf.yml`` to the authorized FoldX executable.
